subtitle: Lesson 1 · What a Technical Architect Actually Does

code:
Administrator:                 Developer:                     Technical Architect:
- configures within            - builds features inside        - decides the shape of the
  established patterns            a scope/flow/app                container itself
- ACLs, notifications,         - Flow Designer, widgets,       - single vs. multi-instance,
  update sets                     scoped apps                     integration pattern, data model
- reversible in minutes        - reversible within the scope   - expensive or impossible to
                                                                    reverse once teams build on it
caption: Same instance, three genuinely different jobs.

code:
Not "hardest work" — "hardest to undo":

Admin/dev decision:              Architect decision:
- local to one team/integration  - binds every future team/integration
- reversed in minutes            - reversed only at major cost, years later
caption: Consequence and reversibility define the boundary, not difficulty.
